notes: Roadmap B5': the two FR3s stand on carts that are pushed away for demos and back for replay. Tags fixed to each cart, seen by the calibrated cameras before and after, tell whether a cart came back where it was registered.

Only differences are used: a reference capture right after registration against a capture after each re-dock, same cameras, same calibration. Tag sizes do not enter the triangulation; black_edge_mm is only checked against the triangulated edges.
left_cart 20-29 is one 2x5 printed strip along the cart's table side (it was called the static scene markers until 10-27). 33/34 are spares for the left cart, not stuck yet.

The table group (45-49) is fixed since 10-27 and checks the cameras, in pixels: each camera's corners of each table tag, reference against current (static_px). A camera that shifted is left out of the carts; when every camera shifted, the table moved and no cart result is trusted. static_reach_m only scales the table's 3D motion, which is shown, not used.

static_px 0.6: 10-27 two captures 2.5 h apart, nothing touched, held every table tag within 0.44 px (largest corner shift; 0.01 deg of camera drift) in every camera. 0.6 px is ~0.035 deg of camera rotation at f ~1000 px. Provisional, like the rest.
Printed 10-27 on a printer that fit the page to 95 %: 33/34/40-49 have a 76 mm black edge (calipers, both directions); 20-29 are 80 mm.

thresholds.provisional: set from 5 push-away/push-back repeats once they are recorded (roadmap B5')
